organs.Notes: Female C57BL/6 mice, LLC tumour-bearing cohort, 8-10 weeks; Pd complex 2 mg/kg or cisplatin 4 mg/kg i.p. daily for 3 consecutive days once tumours reached 8-11 mm. Histology day 25 (caption); origin of day numbering not explicit. Cohort n=10 per arm, histology-specific animal n not stated. Comparator tumour-bearing PBS control 2; healthy PBS control 1 also shown. Separate serum-analysis cohort n=5 healthy mice is not used for this histology. Authors report no marked differences among groups and no tubular necrosis, casts or glomerular congestion. The paper explicitly states evidence is insufficient to conclude on nephrotoxicity. Source: papers/10.1097_cad.0000000000000531.pdf | Methods p.3; Results p.10; Fig.9 p.12
